description: This file defines a web scraper function for extracting recipe data from Epicurious recipe pages. It uses 'request' to fetch HTML content and 'cheerio' to parse and extract specific recipe details such as name, image, ingredients, instructions, tags, time, and servings. The function returns a Promise that resolves with a Recipe object or rejects with an error.

classes.name: RecipeSchema
classes.description: A schema or class for structuring recipe data, imported from a helper module.

methods.name: epicurious
methods.description: Main function that takes a URL, fetches the webpage, parses the HTML, and extracts recipe details into a Recipe object.
